Aged Payables — View

The Aged Payables report displays all outstanding amounts owed to suppliers, organized by how long the invoices have been unpaid.

This report helps you monitor your payment obligations by grouping unpaid invoices into aging periods (current, 30 days, 60 days, 90 days, and over 90 days).

Understanding the Report

Each supplier with outstanding invoices appears as a row in the report, showing the total amount owed broken down by age.

The aging periods help identify which payments are overdue and by how long, allowing you to prioritize payments and manage cash flow effectively.

If a supplier has available credit from overpayments or credit notes, this reduces the total amount owed and is shown in the Less: Credit column.

Report Features

You can expand supplier rows to see individual invoice details, including issue dates and reference numbers.

The report automatically converts foreign currency amounts to your base currency for accurate totals.

When multiple currencies are involved, suppliers are grouped by currency with subtotals for each currency group.

To customize this report, see: Aged Payables — Edit
